name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: Now, you must return to Jaedenar. The braziers are more than likely spread throughout Shadow Hold. Douse each of their flames and the protections the Council has set up will fall for at least a short period of time. I will be waiting for that to happen. When it does, I will look deep within the Hold and try to find out who the head of this beast is. Then, and only then, will we see about attacking them directly.
narrative.objectives: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.
narrative.offerRewardText:
I was able to see you with my spells as soon as the last brazier's flames died. Well done, adventurer.

I learned a few things before the Shadow Council's warlocks were able to recast their spells. Hopefully it will be enough.

For now, rest. I will tell you what I've learned in a moment.
narrative.requestItemsText: The braziers must be extinguished if we are to have any hope of being prepared for a much greater battle. Going in to the dragon's lair without any knowledge is a fool's errand. And this is much worse than a dragon. The Shadow Council are solely responsible for a great number of crimes and atrocities. We'll have to work quickly if we're to stop them.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 51 to 58, 28,900 XP in all.

quests.name: Forces of Jaedenar
quests.objectiveText: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
quests.objectiveText: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
quests.objectiveText: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

quests.name: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood
quests.objectiveText: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

quests.name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
quests.objectiveText: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

quests.name: A Final Blow
quests.objectiveText: Kill Moora and Salia, and bring Shadow Lord Fel'dan's Head to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.
